quiz.prompt: A dial's slope says what a small turn will do to the guess.
quiz.why: Turn it one click and the chance moves by about the slope. That's all training needs to pick a direction.

quiz.prompt: Training turns every dial on every guess.
quiz.why: Only the dials for clue words in the sentence move. The rest had no part in the guess, so their slope is zero.

quiz.prompt: The nudge gets smaller as the guess gets closer.
quiz.why: Should minus guessed shrinks as the guess nears 100%. Small miss, small turn.

quiz.prompt: The computer needs the whole curve to know which way to turn.
quiz.why: It only needs the slope where the dial is now. Then it takes a small step and looks again.
The slope only predicts small turns well. A big jump can land somewhere the slope didn't promise.
